parameters.prompt: A 9-pose hand-drawn looping reaction sticker with a readable silent joke: "High five? Oh, a lily! Curtain call." TWO girls in one fixed waist-up two-shot on solid pure WHITE throughout. Contemporary Chinese chibi artist's rounded shapes, elegant deep plum variable line, restrained cel highlights, peach blush. LEFT ALWAYS: Xingtong, short silver gray side-parted bob, a little cowlick and crossed white hairpins at temple, navy sailor suit with sky-blue tie. RIGHT ALWAYS: Mingqian Nailü, warm taupe low twin tails, yellow-green streak in bangs, heart cowlick, a small pinned white flower at each temple, light green and white florist debut blouse. Their faces visibly DIFFER. The portable lily is large, recognizable, pale cream with orange stamens, dark outline and long single green stem. Hair flowers stay fixed. High-five hand, stem and head directions readable at 100px. Anchor both waists to bottom edge with safe margin at sides and above. One clean silhouette per limb. Nine complete sequential drawings, held cartoon poses, break down as follows. 1 Both rising from small bow with empty hands low at bottom. 2 Left girl beams and raises ONE open greeting palm vertically at center toward right; right looks at palm. 3 Right lifts the single lily from below frame with ONE hand, points its stem toward the open palm. 4 Right delivers stem, left takes it. 5 Right's hand has fully withdrawn to her own chest, Left ALONE holds flower in her high-five hand, freezes with wide eyes looking down at lily. 6 Left still gripping the same stem looks sideways at friend with deadpan surprise; right looks back in earnest, small smile. Hold this comic take. 7 Left recovers her performer's bright smile and presents the same flower at OWN chest. 8 Left gives a deep stage bow with flower; right returns a smaller bow with her empty hands joined. 9 At the low bow flower passes below bottom of frame as hands drop and the pair settle into the opening pose. No dissolves; no motion blur; no impact marks, no text, no effects, no duplicate or elastic hands or flower; keep both actors and camera locked.
